sources.snippet: Overview sam-audio-large is a foundation model from facebook that isolates specific sounds from complex audio mixtures using text descriptions, visual cues from video, or temporal anchors. The model accepts natural language prompts like "a man speaking" or "raindrops falling" and separates the target sound from background audio, outputting both the isolated sound and the residual mixture.
